user.description: General settings shared by all PV arrays. You will configure each array in the next step.

data_description.inverter_power: The AC capacity of a single inverter shared by all arrays in Watt (0 = no limit). Ignored if any array has its own inverter capacity set on the array pages.
data_description.max_snowcover_depth_cm: If greater than 0, the snow cover depth which results in zero module power.
data_description.weather_source: Open-Meteo: weather model from the Open-Meteo API (default). Local: radiation and temperature from Home Assistant entities, e.g. SwissWeather Fusion; no internet access, refreshed every 10 minutes. Hybrid: local for every day the local data fully covers, Open-Meteo for all other days (joined at midnight).

array.description: Settings for PV array {array_number}. Enable “Add another array” to configure an additional array with its own orientation and power.

data_description.modules_power: Total Watt peak power of the solar modules in this array.
data_description.array_inverter_power: The AC capacity of this array's own inverter in Watt (0 = no dedicated inverter). If any array has its own inverter, each array is clamped individually and the shared inverter capacity is ignored.
data_description.damping_morning: 0.0 = no damping, 1.0 = full damping in the morning.
data_description.damping_evening: 0.0 = no damping, 1.0 = full damping in the evening.
data_description.use_horizon: Use the horizon line defined in the horizon file (see docs) to respect shading of the modules.
data_description.partial_shading: Only if horizon is enabled: treat shadows as partial.
data_description.horizon_filepath: Path to the horizon file (leave empty for the default path).

local.description: Local weather source. Select the weather entity that provides the hourly temperature forecast. For SwissWeather Fusion (v0.3.3 or newer) the irradiance and snow-depth sensors are found automatically when left empty.

data_description.local_irradiance_entity: Sensor whose 'hourly_forecast' attribute holds hourly GHI/DNI/DHI (SwissWeather Fusion: Solar irradiance GHI (hour average)). Leave empty to auto-detect.
data_description.local_snow_depth_entity: Optional. Ground snow depth; only used if maximum snow cover depth is greater than 0. Leave empty to auto-detect.
data_description.local_fallback_open_meteo: If the local data is missing or stale, fetch from Open-Meteo instead. When off, the last good forecast is kept (fail-safe, no internet access).

error.weather_no_hourly: This weather entity does not provide an hourly forecast.
error.irradiance_not_found: Irradiance sensor not found (and none could be auto-detected for this weather entity).
error.irradiance_no_series: The sensor has no valid 'hourly_forecast' series with GHI/DNI/DHI.

error.weather_no_hourly: This weather entity does not provide an hourly forecast.
error.irradiance_not_found: Irradiance sensor not found (and none could be auto-detected for this weather entity).
error.irradiance_no_series: The sensor has no valid 'hourly_forecast' series with GHI/DNI/DHI.
